top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Advance on Tech Rebound, Taiwan Jumps: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rebounded from their biggest selloff in more than 18 months, with Taiwan leading gains after local authorities introduced measures to restore investor confidence. Treasuries fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia CEO’s Affair Engulfs AI Giant in Spying Probe
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney and Hong Kong with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Annabelle Droulers, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
